subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Walter near Dawn Winery

736780102.text: Here's some good news. Because people have found concrete evidence of the survival of Snowboars, I just received a letter from my mentor saying that my thesis has been approved.

736780103.text: Wow, sounds like everything's going smoothly for you, eh? Congrats!

736780104.text: It's a good start, but the research that follows will take a long time, so I have to be prepared to stay in Mondstadt for a while.

736780105.text: Next, I have to figure out how the Snowboars managed to leave the snowy mountains and ended up in the forest.

736780106.text: Based on the tracks that have been found, I'm guessing that they descended the mountain from its western face, passed Dawn Winery, and then made their way to Springvale.

736780107.text: If this hypothesis is correct, we should be able to find traces of them in the area. So, our goal today is to investigate this.

736780108.text: Paimon gets it. Uh, also, who is this guy beside you? He looks all dressed for a hunt.

736780109.text: Hello, my name is Walter. Recently, I've taken up the responsibility of overseeing security near Dawn Winery.

736780110.text: Edmund told me that you guys are looking for Snowboars. Could you come with me today? I happen to need some extra hands to help out.

736780111.text: *sigh* Some Forest Boars broke into the nearby farms last night, scaring off all their pigeons and ducks. They still haven't found all of them.

736780112.text: Traveler, when we are hunting later, please capture these small animals when you find them and bring them back with you.

736780114.text: I heard that you know how to use hunting tools. I've got some around here too, so help yourself. We can set off once you're ready.

736780117.text: Yeah, take your time. I'll be waiting right here.

subQuests.subQuestName: Participate in the hunt near Dawn Winery
